0x0008DF.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x000911.en: 「At my level now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000982.en: 「Gah!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000A0A.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000B33.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B6B.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000C34.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I get...!」

0x000C6F.en: 「You think I'd blow it here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000CC3.en: 「Blew it...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000DAD.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000E14.en: 「This is my limit... the rest is yours.」

0x000E46.en: 「Dammit...!@ So this is where it ends!」

0x000E82.en: 「Nngh! Took the worst of it, did I...」

0x000EC0.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000F0D.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F4B.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F92.en: 「To think the Granzon would be shot down...」

0x00103D.en: 「Nngh... to think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001179.en: 「U... ngh! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0011E6.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00122D.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001262.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x00134E.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm not there yet...!」

0x00139C.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x001486.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0014C4.en: 「Well well, so this is the end.」

0x0014F3.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x00157E.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0016E4.en: 「Ejecting...@ ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x001911.en: 「So I've still got a ways to go...!」

0x0019B4.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x001A81.en: (Why... won't he use his usual trick to break away...?)

0x001B10.en: 「So there were still that many of them.」

0x001B3B.en: 「They may be reinforcements. In that case...」

0x001B72.en: 「Understood.@ I'll charge in and cut them all down together!」

0x001C13.en: 「Roger.@ Jinrai shows no sign of trying to flee.」

0x001C7C.en: 「Captain,@ we're getting a transmission from Ms. Minaki Tomine.@ She says she has something to discuss about Jinrai.」

0x001D0C.en: 「Understood. Patch her through.@ Also, put Major Sanger, Ratsel,@ and Major Kai on the line.」

0x001DB0.en: 「...This is Tomine.@ Captain, I have a request I know is unreasonable.」

0x001E18.en: 「We're mid-battle, so keep it brief if you can.」

0x001E4C.en: 「Yes.@ Rather than destroy Jinrai,@ I want you to capture it.」

0x001EC2.en: 「Even if Jinrai falls to the two Double Gs here,@ it will only deepen my father's obsession...」

0x001F33.en: 「So I want to reforge Jinrai with my own hands@ and prove its worth.@ Not by defeating two Double Gs...」

0x001FF0.en: 「But by fighting the enemy it should fight,@ and driving off the threat looming over Earth's sphere.」

0x002052.en: 「And right now, Jinrai@ is part of that very threat. You understand that?」

0x0020A8.en: 「I do.@ But even if it was built for a twisted purpose,@ I'm asking you to give it the chance to be set right.」

0x002159.en: 「...There's no ulterior motive behind those words?」

0x002193.en: 「...No.@ You may not believe me, but...」

0x0021E6.en: 「Captain, Minaki means it!@ Ever since the Mass-Produced Jinrai attacked Asakusa,@ she's been in pain over it!」

0x002276.en: 「That's why I want to save that Jinrai...!」

0x0022F1.en: 「True, Jinrai is a threat. But turn that around,@ and it could become a dependable force for us.@ ...Ms. Minaki, what's the specific method?」

0x0023AB.en: 「We remove System ZLAI from Jinrai@ and remodel it into a human-piloted machine.」

0x00243B.en: 「Yes. At Dr. Bian Zoldark's design stage,@ Jinrai was a man-machine unit. It has no@ JINKI-1 installed, but...」

0x002501.en: 「A 'System LIOH,' built to link with a pilot,@ is incorporated into it.」

0x0025A0.en: 「Right now it's kept dormant,@ and in its place the AI, System ZLAI,@ controls the machine.」

0x00263F.en: 「So we fully remove that@ and reforge it as a machine@ controlled by a human being.」

0x0026FA.en: 「If it truly means a change of heart...@ it would become a dependable asset for us.」

0x00279F.en: 「Provided we get clearance to destroy it@ if capture proves impossible.」

0x0027F8.en: 「Then, changing the mission objective.@ After destroying all Mass-Produced Jinrai,@ lure Jinrai in and capture it.」

0x00287F.en: 「Sanger, first we clean up the mass-production units!」

0x002941.en: 「Now, lure Jinrai into the designated area.」

0x002978.en: 「Then flank it from two sides and disable it!」

0x0029B5.en: 「Guardian 1 to all units.@ Jinrai's after DyGenGuard.@ I'll draw it into the designated area.」

0x002A48.en: 「Then the two of us pin it down and strike.@ Leave it unable to resist.」

0x002B77.en: 「Hold it there and remove System ZLAI.@ ...Are you all right with that, Ms. Minaki?」

0x002BEB.en: 「...Yes.@ Thank you for your consideration, Captain.」

0x002C7C.en: 「Albero,@ Second Lieutenant Hugo is chasing us alone.」

0x002D5D.en: 「I won't hesitate to fight the 'enemy'...@ that's what you taught me, after all.」

0x002DCE.en: 「But why did you take Mitarl Zapad's offer?@ Why are you siding with the Gaia Sabers?」

0x002E54.en: 「Never mind me,@ you've got no reason to lend them a hand!」

0x002EE5.en: 「But you don't need to know it.@ ...No, better that you don't.」

0x002F69.en: 「The talk ends here.@ You'll become fodder for Medius.」

0x00301F.en: 「Albero, be sure to show no mercy.」

0x003059.en: 「I know.@ Don't let AI1 trigger a rejection reaction.」

0x0030B3.en: (AI1... there's nothing to fear.@ Through the pain, you'll grow stronger...)

0x003124.en: (So don't reject it. Accept the anguish.@ And if your machine is torn apart because of it, I'll get you out.@ Without fail.)

0x0031C9.en: 「Why are you after us!?@ What is this 'fodder for Medius'!?」

0x003244.en: 「Of course!@ I know I'm being played by Mitarl,@ but I don't intend to end it like that!」

0x0032D1.en: 「If you want the truth that badly,@ come at me for real! Otherwise,@ you'll die!」

0x003361.en: 「You don't have to tell me that!」

0x003398.en: 「Hugo,@ I've tightened the renewal interval@ on Medius's predicted pattern data!」

0x00345D.en: (...It's useless, Aqua.@ As long as you rely on the system.)

0x0034B0.en: (Even if he does arrive at the ideal answer...@　that will only feed AI1's growth.)

0x003565.en: (N-not now...!@　The medicine's wearing off even faster...!)

0x0035E9.en: 「I-I'm fine! Just focus on your own job!」

0x003661.en: 「You held out well. But this is the end!」

0x0036EB.en: (Of course.@　AI1 is growing in real time.)

0x00375D.en: 「Hugo, you can't beat Medius.@　Not in that body of yours.」

0x00381E.en: 「I'll give you one last chance.@　...Come to my side.」

0x0038C7.en: 「You're near your limit, aren't you, Hugo?@　The only way to keep that body going is@　to let Mitarl adjust you.」

0x00397C.en: 「S-so that's it...@　You want me to keep wagging my tail...」

0x0039C9.en: 「Under Mitarl, like you!@ You want me to be Gaia Sabers' dog!?」

0x003A4F.en: 「Listen, the real reason I follow him is...」

0x003A9F.en: 「I'll hear it once I've dragged you@　out of that Medius!」

0x003AFB.en: 「Aqua, release the TE limiter!@　It's the only way to beat Medius!」

0x003BB9.en: 「! Hugo, three o'clock, ten degrees down!@　Left shoulder thruster, two-second burn!」

0x003C28.en: (AI1 couldn't read the move!?@　Aqua, predicting without the system!?)

0x003CD1.en: 「Kh...!@　This is critical. I'm handing all@　unit control over to AI1.」

0x003D6B.en: 「Are you prepared to lose both AI1 and@　Medius here...!?」

0x003E1D.en: (I won't let AI1... my child... die.@　This child still has so much room to grow...)

0x003E88.en: (I won't let anyone stop that... I won't let him die here.)

0x003ED4.en: (! @　AI1, you... You're saying you can still fight?)

0x003F21.en: (Yes, that's it. That's my child.@　I'll buy you time.)

0x003F86.en: 「Hugo!@　I'll be dead in the water in 34 seconds!@　Take out Medius, quick!」

0x003FF5.en: 「Hold it right there.@　I won't let you kill my child.」

0x00405B.en: 「Th-that voice... N-no, it can't be, Professor Mitte!?」

0x0040CC.en: 「N-no way!!@　Why are you in Medius, Professor!?」

0x004119.en: 「For the record, I joined the Zentr@　Project before you did.」

0x004199.en: 「!!@　Th-then you knew from the start...!?」

0x0041E6.en: 「Hehehe...@　Thanks to you, my child has learned true pain.@　And now he'll draw out the power he needs to survive.」

0x00428B.en: 「Aqua, output's dropping! Get to the blue zone!」

0x0042ED.en: 「I'll show you now what that leads to.」

0x00436E.en: 「Unit control transfer complete.@　Rasmnanium, CA limiter released.」

0x0044B6.en: 「Now, AI1... Show them everything you've learned...@　your true power!」

0x00456B.en: 「What is this!?@　What's happening to Medius!?」

0x0045BB.en: 「Hehehe, don't be so surprised.@　This is Rasmnanium's...@　no, my AI1's true power.」

0x00464E.en: 「Impossible! I was told nothing of this!」

0x00468B.en: 「That's because...@　there was no need to tell you.」

0x004756.en: 「Kh, I can't dodge it all! Aqua!!」

0x00480E.en: 「What happened to Hugo... What happened to him!?」

0x004854.en: 「No sign of him. No life signs, either.@　He is presumed dead.」

0x00490F.en: 「Had he not shielded it, the cockpit@　would've been completely destroyed...」

0x00499C.en: 「You deceived Doctor Zapad and me,@　tried to chase two hares at once, Albero.@　But this is the result.」

0x004A29.en: 「Even your actions became the trigger@　that pushed AI1 to an even higher@　stage of evolution...」

0x004AA7.en: 「I'll overlook your attempt to recruit@　Lieutenant Medio. For your child's sake, too.」

0x004B89.en: 「Aqua, Lieutenant Medio's death is on you.」

0x004BCC.en: 「Your panic gave Medius time to evolve...@　and in the end, it led him to his death.」

0x004C43.en: 「Do you know why I hid the fact that I was@　piloting Medius from you?」

0x004CDF.en: 「Yes. To provoke that panic of yours at a@　moment like this. Because I know@　you carry that kind of fragility.」

0x004DA9.en: 「I taught you once. In any situation,@　analyze it calmly and be ready to@　respond to anything.」

0x004EC9.en: 「Thanks to you, I've reached the next@　stage sooner than expected.@　As my thanks...」

0x004F3B.en: 「I'll send you to join Lieutenant Medio.」

0x004FD4.en: 「Is it because it just evolved and isn't@ stable...!? Or is it something else...?」

0x00503C.en: 「...We're withdrawing, Erde.@　Fighting the Steel Dragons in this@　unstable state is too dangerous.」

0x00513B.en: 「There's one more TE Absorber, isn't there?@　Learn from today, and become its pilot.」

0x0051D7.en: 「Then come and challenge the reborn@　Medius Locus.」

0x005236.en: 「If you have the will for it, that is.」

0x005271.en: 「Medius Locus is withdrawing from the battle zone!」

0x0052D0.en: 「Their unit appears to be badly damaged!」

0x005301.en: 「Recover them at once! Send a medical team to the deck!@　All other units, maintain strict anti-air watch!」

0x0053CB.en: 「I-it's my... it's my fault...@　I panicked over Professor Mitte, and...」

0x00544F.en: 「Erde Mitte...@　She was an instructor back when I@　was at the officers' academy...@　She handled the <TC-OS> architecture arrangement...」

0x0054F3.en: 「Th-that woman... was part of the@　Zentr Project all this time...@　and she was even piloting Medius...」

0x005595.en: 「Th-the Professor... she knew...@　and all this time she... u-uuu...」

0x005610.en: 「And yet... I... Because of me, Hugo...@　Hugo is...!!」

0x0056AC.en: 「But... but...@　Hugo's body... he said his limit was near...」

0x005724.en: 「What was wrong with Lieutenant Medio's body...?」

0x005758.en: 「...In the fight with Jetzt, he was gravely wounded, then taken in by the Zentr Project, which had ties to that monster...」

0x00582A.en: 「What he lost was replaced by Mitarl Zapad.」

0x0058F1.en: 「And his artificial bones had what looked@　like Rasmnanium put into them.」

0x005956.en: 「The medicine he always took suppressed his@　rejection reactions and slowed Rasmnanium's activity...@　and only Doctor Zapad could compound it.」

0x005A2B.en: 「He was most likely using Lieutenant Medio@　as a test subject for Rasmnanium...」

0x005ADC.en: 「His whole body would be eaten by Rasmnanium,@　and he'd die... His very body was a shackle.」

0x005B6B.en: 「H-he never said a word of that... to me...」

0x005BA5.en: 「He didn't want to burden you or make@　you worry, most likely...」

0x005C53.en: 「...The trouble with Gaia Sabers made the@ medicine hard to get... He had only about@ ten days' worth left.」

0x005D0E.en: 「Once we reached Iti Iti Island, I meant to@　pull him out of the TE Absorber. I urged him@　to tell Aqua the truth, too, but...」

0x005DCE.en: 「Hugo said... he'd tell me the truth@　once we reached the island...」

0x005E52.en: 「He put me through simulator training,@　brought up releasing the TE limiter...@　all because his time was running out...」

0x005F89.en: 「No... I should have forced him out.@　This is my responsibility...」

0x005FF4.en: 「Could you... leave me alone for a while...」

0x00607E.en: (Why... Why, Professor Mitte...@　Why did she do this to me...?)

0x0060E6.en: (I don't understand... So much has happened...)

0x006129.en: (Hugo... What... what am I supposed to do...?)

0x0061EA.en: 「...This TE Absorber is beyond@　salvaging now.」

0x0062EE.en: 「Look at the damage... the torso especially.@　The limbs took a heavy impact and are crushed,@　yet the wound looks as if it were cut clean off...」

0x0063A8.en: 「And the TE engine was taken too,@　module and all.」

0x006432.en: 「The Zentr Project side must have TE engines@　of their own. If they wanted to capture the@　unit, fine, but...」

0x0064D1.en: 「Why take in the engine right there?@　And along with Lieutenant Medio, no less...」

0x00655E.en: 「I suspect this result wasn't something@　the other side anticipated either...@　That's what I think.」

0x0065DF.en: 「Even though Medius Locus achieved evolution,@　they couldn't capture or shoot it down...@　You mean the result was left half-finished?」

0x0066A0.en: 「And after cornering us this far, their reason@　for retreating makes no sense. Was there some malfunction?」

0x006729.en: 「That only Lieutenant Aqua survived, and that@　the TE engine was seized, may have been@　unexpected for them as well.」

0x0067D7.en: 「Unexpected or not, it was Major Albero@　piloting Medius. Aqua aside, seizing a TE@　engine unintentionally is...」

0x00689A.en: 「Consider it with the Rasmnanium factor@　in mind.」

0x0068F6.en: 「That thing doesn't just repair damage.@　It drastically altered Medius Locus's shape,@　size, even its properties.」

0x00699B.en: 「In other words, power on par with the@　<Machine Cell>... What if it even has the@　ability to erode and dominate?」

0x006A55.en: 「A-ahh...@　The Rasmnanium detected in Lieutenant@　Medio's body showed signs of it...」

0x006AD3.en: 「So Lieutenant Hugo and the TE Engine@　were absorbed by the Rasmnanium...?」

0x006B4D.en: 「With no connection to Major Albero's intent...?」

0x006B8A.en: 「The TE Engine aside,@ we're missing the pieces we'd need to explain why Lieutenant Hugo was absorbed...」

0x006C2C.en: 「Something controlling the Rasmnanium@　may well be involved.」

0x006C94.en: 「Either way... there's no changing the fact@　that we've lost Lieutenant Hugo...」

0x006D0B.en: （Hugo Medio... so your dark luck's run dry.@　Or has it...?）

0x006DC1.en: 「My Jinrai's been stolen!@　Wh-what in the world were you doing!?」

0x006E2F.en: 「With respect, until we captured the target@　we acted exactly per Delta's orders.@　We even aided Jinrai's withdrawal...」

0x006EE6.en: 「It's what came after that's the problem!」

0x006F0B.en: 「I did state that once the target was captured,@　I'd be acting on my own judgment, did I not?」

0x006F95.en: 「An unfortunate result on our end as well...@　but as before, we'll continue sharing@　data between AI1 and AI0.」

0x00703A.en: （Though AI1's data is a decoy, of course.）

0x00707A.en: 「Forget AI1 -@　my ZLAI system is far more important!」

0x0070D9.en: 「...I must report to Dr. Zapad,@　so if you'll excuse me.」

0x007135.en: 「D-damn you...! Damn you, Steel Dragons...!@　I won't let this stand!」

0x00719D.en: 「And Minaki!@　Why can't I reach you at a time like this!?@　Just where are you and what are you doing!?」

0x007243.en: 「I see... so Lieutenant Hugo is dead.」

0x00727A.en: 「Well done, Major Albero. I'll be honest -@　where Lieutenant Hugo was concerned, I had my doubts about you...@　wondering if, in the end, you meant to save him too.」

0x007352.en: 「Leave Warrant Officer Foglia to me as before.@　...You may go now.」

0x0073CF.en: 「Before that, there's something I want to ask.」

0x007410.en: 「It's about Medius changing shape.@　I was never told that AI1 and Rasmnanium@　were capable of something like that.」

0x0074C4.en: 「That was classified.@　And it's no concern of yours.@　Just focus on being a pilot.」

0x00754B.en: 「That's for your son's sake as well.」

0x00757F.en: 「...Is it truly all right to leave Albero be?」

0x0075CB.en: 「Yes. It seems we still need a coachman.@　Especially if things like this keep happening.」

0x00765B.en: 「I'll grant the evolution of Medius Locus.@　But absorbing the TE Engine and parts...@　was that on your orders?」

0x00772E.en: 「Then doesn't that mean you@　can't fully control AI1?」

0x007799.en: 「To produce the results we desire,@　the child needed still greater power.」

0x00780A.en: 「Through all its experience,@　it's grown able to make such judgments.@　You could call it wonderful growth.」

0x0078AC.en: 「No, it's a dangerous sign. If AI1 keeps learning@　and comes to crave more power, then what?」

0x007941.en: 「Giving a child what it wants is a parent's duty.」

0x007981.en: 「I'm saying it could run out of control.」

0x007A13.en: 「It's that very AI1 I'm worried about.@　This is where I draw the line. What's absorbed is done,@　but readjust the limiter.」

0x007ADC.en: 「If you can't rein in AI1,@　I'll have to reconsider the MODEL-X matter.」

0x007B50.en: （To think it would come to that...）

0x007B8D.en: （I've done something I can never take back...）

0x007BD6.en: （Like this... even if Foglia wakes,@　I couldn't face her...）

0x007C35.en: （Hugo... I couldn't save you...@　I shut off your path...）

0x007CB6.en: 「Hmph... so Jinrai and Medius Locus@　weren't enough to summon the Godservant.」

0x007D40.en: 「I'll have Alpha and Beta continue the pursuit.」

0x007D83.en: 「Depending on the situation, we'll deploy Omega too.」

0x007DDF.en: 「The mass-production types are for later operations...@　and can serve as sacrificial pawns as well.@　Leave them as they are.」

0x007E60.en: 「Sir.@　Also, Medius Locus produced some@　intriguing results. This is the summary data.」

0x007F03.en: 「Though Dr. Zapad seems reluctant about it.」

0x007F43.en: 「The question is how far this can transform.@　Depending on the result, it may become a linchpin of my plan.」

0x007FBD.en: 「Then shall we prioritize the Erde Mitte plan?」

0x008009.en: 「No, Zapad's.@　That way she'll rouse herself, won't she?」

0x0080A9.en: 「The second production batch of Psylion arrives soon.@ This time with pilots... Araceli Garcia,@ a mercenary in Mitsuko Isurugi's employ.」

0x008178.en: 「Ah... she did mention something to that effect.」

0x0081BE.en: 「Could he mean to probe our intentions?」

0x0081F2.en: 「Likely so.@　Issue his unit orders to pursue the Steel Dragons.」

0x008254.en: 「If he wants in on the Saber project, tell him he'll need@ a gift beyond the Psylion before coming here.」

0x00831B.en: 「Reporting. A message has arrived@　addressed to Commander Alteur.」

0x008437.en: 「...I've contacted you directly@　because there's a favor I must ask.」

0x0084BA.en: 「So that's why I was pulled@　from Araceli Garcia's team...」

0x008519.en: 「Then again, even without this matter,@ I've no intention of handing the Vegalion@ over to the Gaia Sabers.」

0x0085A6.en: 「<Project TD> benefits our company@　both openly and behind the scenes.」

0x008604.en: 「...So what is it you want me to do?」

0x008635.en: 「I'd like you to join the Steel Dragons@　as my special envoy.」

0x008691.en: 「Normally I'd reach out to them directly@　or through an intermediary...」

0x0086FC.en: 「But given the hidden Project TD,@　they won't trust us so easily, will they?」

0x00877C.en: 「So I thought I'd send you - one of the parties involved,@　and one with ties to the Steel Dragons.」

0x008808.en: 「...Do you know what my true aim is?」

0x00884B.en: 「Yes.@　But I have hopes for Orihime and Hikoboshi's reunion too, you know?」

0x0088E1.en: 「In any case, this request bears heavily@　not only on Project TD and the Steel Dragons,@　but on our fortunes as well.」

0x00897D.en: 「To put it grandly, Earth's future is at stake.」

0x0089F1.en: 「My, you've no reason to refuse, have you?@　"HYPER77"... it's indispensable@　to fulfilling your brother's dream.」

0x008ACC.en: 「Whether you obtain it alone, or...@　If you'll carry out my request without fail,@　I promise you even greater support.」

0x008B8F.en: （...For me to realize my brother's dream...）
